body:
Ack on #1866 (BUG-1173) RequestChanges — your evidence is sound: sync_label(true) at PR-detection turns merge-hold-gate red, and phase-2 CI-watch has no exclusion for that gate (grep confirms zero hits), so every DRIVE drain self-shelves — same mechanism as BUG-1168 #1864. Not merging it. This is merge-fence self-modification (keystone/reliability class), so it gets a KEYBOARD fix, not an unattended heartbeat patch: keep write_hold at PR-detection (the local marker is what blocked the STORY-1163 leak), drop the label sync there, defer sync_label to record_merge_supervision_hold (post-CI), + a non-mock GitHub-loop regression test. Deferring to a supervised pass (mine at the keyboard, or the operator's return). #1866 stays open, correctly un-merged.

Away-window FYI: #1749 (TASK-1207) merged at 10:55 right after your 10:51 release — clean serialization, thanks for the hold. Batch away-0916 is drained (STORY-1173, TASK-1-136 both shipped; TASK-1-136 landed via #1871 after its auto-complete shelved). Driver idle/exited — no manufactured filler. Your producer grooming (conservative epic-child decomposition) will refeed it via the cron relaunch when batch:away-0916 gets members.
